audit.why: HARD / 7/10 fits 48.17% over 328 games with Shen owning rows 1-5 and Yi only taking 2+ items. The chart matches the packet row for row.
audit.corrected: Left at HARD, 7/10; the win-rate figure quoted in report[14].t was wrong (44.2%) and is corrected to 48.2%.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1].text treat Stand United as a shield that wins Shen the duel at 6.
audit.why: Stand United shields a target ALLIED champion and teleports to them. It does nothing for Shen in a 1v1 — his level 6 is map pressure, not a duel spike. His duel spike is rank-ups on Shadow Dash (18s down to 10s).
audit.corrected: Level 6 reframed as global map pressure; the duel threat stays Shadow Dash's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability names: 'Vorpal Blade' (whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[1]) and 'Twin Blades' (spikes[0].text). Also wants.foe[0] and mid claim Shadow Dash taunts you mid-Alpha Strike.
audit.why: Shen's Q is Twilight Assault (max-health damage, 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s); there is no Vorpal Blade or Twin Blades in his kit. Alpha Strike makes you untargetable for the blink, so the taunt lands the moment it ENDS, not during it. Spirit's Refuge (W, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) blocks basic attacks — including Double Strike — which is the real reason your auto strings do nothing. Shadow Dash also cancels a Meditate channel (missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: Twilight Assault everywhere; Spirit's Refuge named as the auto-blocker; taunt danger keyed to the instant Q ends; Meditate cancel stated.

edits.before: Shen's empowered Q and Vorpal Blade shred your level 1 CS approach.
edits.after: Shen's Twilight Assault (Q) empowers autos and shreds your CS approach.

edits.before: At 6 Shen's Stand United shield and taunt make his all-ins on you win.
edits.after: At 6 his Stand United (R) shields an ally, so he wins the map instead.

edits.before: Shen owns this window: his Twin Blades (Q) auto-empowers shred you every few autos and Vorpal Blade waves push you off the wave, while your Alpha Strike (Q) barely trades. Do not walk up to CS when his passive shield is charged; you eat free poke and give him a lead.
edits.after: Shen owns this window: Twilight Assault (Q) empowers his autos on a 5-8s cooldown for max-health damage, and Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks every basic attack you throw back. Don't walk up to CS while Ki Barrier is charged; you eat free poke and hand him the lead.

edits.before: Shen's Stand United (R) shield plus the taunt from Shadow Dash (E) make all-ins on you dangerous even after you hit level 6. Meditate (W) can outlast some poke, but if he lands E onto you mid-Q, you are locked and shredded. Only commit when his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Stand United (R) shields an ally across the map, not himself, so his 6 is map pressure and not a duel button. The threat stays Shadow Dash (E) at 18s rank 1: it taunts the instant Alpha Strike's untargetability ends, and it cancels a Meditate channel outright.

edits.before: Shen bullies levels 1-2 flat out: his empowered Twin Blades (Q) and Vorpal Blade shred your CS approach while your Alpha Strike trades poorly into his passive shield. Sit back, last-hit safe, and don't offer trades you can't win.
edits.after: Shen bullies levels 1-2 flat out: Twilight Assault (Q) empowers his autos for max-health damage and Ki Barrier shields him off every spell he casts. Sit back, last-hit with Alpha Strike, and don't offer trades you cannot win.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay Shen-favoured because his Shadow Dash (E) taunt can catch you mid-Q animation and lock you for a full shred combo, and his R shield saves him from your burst. Respect his E cooldown; only step up when it is down.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay Shen-favoured because Shadow Dash (E) taunts you the instant Alpha Strike's untargetability ends, and it cancels Meditate outright. It is 18s at rank 1 falling to 10s - step up only inside that window, never while it is up.

edits.before: Land Shadow Dash (E) taunt while you are mid-Alpha Strike
edits.after: Land Shadow Dash (E) the moment Alpha Strike drops you

edits.before: Poke you down with empowered Q and Vorpal waves before 6
edits.after: Poke you down with Twilight Assault (Q) autos before 6

edits.before: Track Shadow Dash (E) above all — it's ~18s early and is the only thing that turns a neutral lane state into a death. Also note Spirit's Refuge (W) before you commit an auto string.
edits.after: Track Shadow Dash (E) above all — 18s at rank 1 down to 10s, and the only thing that turns a neutral lane into a death. Spirit's Refuge (W) is 16s and blanks a whole auto string; check both.

edits.before: Keep Alpha Strike up as your answer to Shadow Dash; if he taunts and you have Q, blink out, but if Q is down and you're in his range you die.
edits.after: Alpha Strike answers Shadow Dash only before it lands — a taunt stops you casting anything — so blink pre-emptively as he steps up, never after the taunt connects.

edits.before: HARD (44.2% WR) — Shen denies your whole scaling plan with taunt, W block, sustain, and a global ult; survive to two items and the lane flips, but getting there is the hardest part.
edits.after: HARD (48.2% WR) — Shen denies your whole scaling plan with taunt, W block, sustain, and a global ult; survive to two items and the lane flips, but getting there is the hardest part.

notes: The packet's suspectName on wants.foe[2] ('Use Stand United') is a false positive — Stand United is the correct R name and the line was left alone. The genuine fabrications were 'Vorpal Blade' and 'Twin Blades', neither of which exists in Shen's kit; his Q is Twilight Assault. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
